description: Android activity class that demonstrates applying different interpolators to a translation animation based on user selection from a spinner.

classes.name: Animation3
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates applying different interpolators to an animation based on user selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the spinner with interpolator options, and assigns the item selected listener.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles spinner selection, creates and configures a translation animation with the selected interpolator, and starts the animation on the target view.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Empty implementation for when no spinner item is selected.
